text:
rajesh: Putting a hold on the release window. Staging CI failing while fetching wheel artifact; deploy-bot reports checksum mismatch and cache-lease timeouts.
mia: Paste the deploy-bot excerpt?
rajesh: logs:
```
[deploy-bot] GET https://artifacts.internal/wheels/app-2.0.0.whl -> 200
[deploy-bot] downloaded 7,128,192 bytes
[deploy-bot] sha256 mismatch (expected=9e1f..., actual=2c7b...)
[deploy-bot] cache-lease acquire -> lease=locked ttl=20s -> timeout
[deploy-bot] promote aborted: integrity-check-failed attempts=4
```
deploy-bot: auto-promote suspended for R-2026-03-21-7 by request; manual intervention required.
sam: Could be a bad multipart finalize or a stale cache shard. Ops: can infra reupload or invalidate?
infra-bot: Found a stale shard on objectstore node 7; invalidation pushed for key wheels/app-2.0.0.whl, queued CDN purge.
mia: For safety let's pin routing to current running digest (sha256:77aa88) and keep the release paused. We'll reupload and verify.
rajesh: Done: `/deploybot suspend R-2026-03-21-7` and routing pinned to sha256:77aa88 for 30m. I'll draft a short note: "Release delayed: artifact integrity check; pinned to previous image while we verify artifact; ETA ~25m."
sam: Reuploading final object now with complete-multipart-upload, will run sha256sum and report.
infra-bot: CDN purge in progress after reupload; invalidation should remove stale parts.
sam: Reupload complete. New object sha256=9e1f... verified. Push finished and metadata updated.
mia: Running quick smoke and integration against the new wheel.
deploy-bot: pre-promote smoke queued.
mia: Smoke + integration OK. No DB migration required. Ready for manual promote.
deploy-bot: Manual promote authorized by rajesh. Promoting artifact (sha256=9e1f...) with controlled rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
rajesh: Thanks team. Removing hold after rollout completes; follow-ups: add CI preflight to validate objectstore shard health and multipart-finalize, and an alert for checksum mismatches above threshold. sam, can you file those?
sam: Will do (PLAT-1402).
rajesh: I'll post the release note to #release-announcements and close the window once rollout hits 100%. :white_check_mark:
